new_covariate.name: term_spread
new_covariate.formula: (close_price_main_contract - close_price_5th_month_contract) / ATR(14) of main contract. Normalized spread between nearest active futures month and the 5th-month futures, measuring curve steepness/flatness.
new_covariate.mechanism: 期货曲线近远月价差(term_spread)直接反映现货/近月供需紧张度。正价差加深=当期供应偏紧或现货需求强劲，价格上行；负价差=供应充裕或需求疲软。对豆粕而言，近远月价差直接反映压榨利润驱动的库存压力：m1相对m5走强=物理市场需求超过压榨供给能力，确认上行趋势。价差变化还领先于库存数据公布，因为期货跨期套利者提前定价供需变化。

proposal.symbol_fit: 豆粕是中国期货成交量最大的农产品品种之一，主力合约(1-5-9月)流动性充足，近远月价差计算可靠。豆粕的压榨利润(crush margin)是核心基本面驱动因素，近远月价差直接反映压榨企业的当期供需博弈。豆粕有明确的季节性(四季度春节前备货需求、夏季水产需求旺季)，近远月价差在季节性需求启动前就会提前反映。此外，豆粕的持仓量大、交割月集中，近远月价差的信号质量高于其他品种。
proposal.kill_condition: aligned ev<0 或 ic<0.02 即放弃
proposal.promote_condition: aligned gate_pass 且 PF>1.05 且 ev>0

new_covariate.name: oi_weighted_momentum
new_covariate.formula: tanh(price_pct_change_5d * oi_change_rate_5d * scaling_factor); price_pct_change=5日价格变化率; oi_change_rate=5日持仓量变化率; tanh归一化至[-1,1]
new_covariate.mechanism: 持仓量变化加权动量:价格动量仅在持仓量同步增长时(增仓=资金流入)才有效——增仓上涨=多头主动建仓,增仓下跌=空头主动建仓,缩量(减仓)行情中价格动量不可信。交互项tanh(Δprice×Δoi)编码了这一'量价验证'逻辑:同号(增仓+上涨=正动量;增仓+下跌=负动量)给出强方向信号;异号(减仓行情)信号衰减至零。本质是Hurst体制门控的价格动量,但用持仓量替代Hurst作为体制判据,更直接反映资金流。

proposal.symbol_fit: 豆粕(m)是信息驱动型品种:USDA月度报告(供需预估/种植面积/收获进度)触发资金集中进出,报告前后的持仓量变化是机构资金流的直接度量。oi_weighted_momentum在m上的适配性:USDA报告→机构调整头寸(Δoi↑)→价格方向性运动(Δprice↑)→两者交互产生强信号。非报告期间,散户调仓(Δoi↓)主导,价格动量噪声大→交互项衰减。m的大豆进口依存度>80%,CBOT传导链使得持仓量变化领先价格(机构先建头寸再驱动价格),oi_weighted_momentum捕捉这一领先关系。
proposal.kill_condition: aligned dir_acc<0.52 或 endpoint_mape 未优于基线即放弃
proposal.promote_condition: aligned gate_pass 且 fdr_pass (DirAcc 口径)

new_covariate.name: stoch_rsi
new_covariate.formula: Stochastic RSI = (RSI(14) - lowest(RSI(14),14)) / (highest(RSI(14),14) - lowest(RSI(14),14)) * 100, smoothed with 3-period SMA
new_covariate.mechanism: 通过随机化处理将RSI映射到0-100的超买超卖区间并平滑，过滤传统RSI在高波动环境中的噪声，更敏感地识别极端市场情绪的反转信号，减少假突破。

proposal.symbol_fit: 豆粕波动率较高，传统RSI容易在噪声中失效。Stoch RSI通过随机化处理过滤部分噪声，更适合高波品种的情绪识别。
proposal.kill_condition: aligned dir_acc < m effective_min (0.520) 即放弃
proposal.promote_condition: aligned gate_pass 且 fdr_pass (DirAcc 口径)

new_covariate.name: oi_gated_ha_body
new_covariate.formula: ha_body_direction * max(0, oi_change_rate)  # OI非负门控(半波整流)乘以HA实体方向
new_covariate.mechanism: 结合OI门控与HA实体平滑：OI门控验证机构资金流入(增仓激活/减仓归零)，HA实体方向识别经平滑后的持续动能方向，过滤单根K线噪声与假突破。机构增仓时HA实体动能提供方向确认。

proposal.symbol_fit: 为何是m: 豆粕流动性高、机构参与度高，OI门控能有效区分套保盘与投机盘，HA平滑则过滤高频噪声，适合1H预测尺度。
proposal.predicted_direction: oi增仓且HA实体为正 -> long; oi增仓且HA实体为负 -> short
proposal.kill_condition: aligned dir_acc低于该品种adaptive effective_min即放弃
proposal.promote_condition: aligned gate_pass且fdr_pass(DirAcc口径)

new_covariate.name: pmi
new_covariate.formula: 官方制造业采购经理人指数（月度发布），用线性插值填充日级别。信号：PMI>50扩张期看多工业品，PMI<50收缩期看空，拐点领先实体经济周期。
new_covariate.mechanism: 宏观景气周期通过制造业开工率影响螺纹钢需求：钢铁下游（机械/汽车/家电）采购意愿与库存策略随宏观周期调整，官方月度高频指标提前2-4周反映需求拐点，政策市中宏观信号权重高。

proposal.symbol_fit: 为何是rb: 螺纹钢为强周期工业品，建筑业与制造业双重需求，宏观指标（如官方制造业/建筑业PMI）直接驱动需求预期，比日线技术指标更能捕捉周期拐点。
proposal.kill_condition: aligned dir_acc < 0.52 (rb品种adaptive gate) 即放弃
proposal.promote_condition: aligned gate_pass 且 fdr_pass (DirAcc 口径)

new_covariate.name: crack_spread_acceleration
new_covariate.mechanism: 裂解价差加速度捕捉钢厂利润变化速率：价差斜率的二阶导数反映利润扩张/收缩的加速或衰减，利润加速扩张期钢厂增产预期推升螺纹需求，利润加速收缩期减产预期压制价格；加速度比斜率更早捕捉利润周期拐点，在政策刺激频繁的工业品上提供领先信号。

proposal.symbol_fit: 为何是rb: 螺纹钢裂解价差（废钢-螺纹）受电炉开工率与政策调控敏感，利润变化速率在刺激政策发布前后常出现脉冲；加速度指标比静态价差或一阶梯度更敏感捕捉钢厂生产决策的边际变化，工业品利润周期比农产品榨季更具政策弹性。
proposal.predicted_direction: 价差加速度转正（利润加速扩张） -> long, 加速度转负（利润加速收缩） -> short
proposal.kill_condition: aligned dir_acc 低于该品种 adaptive effective_min 即放弃
proposal.promote_condition: aligned gate_pass 且 fdr_pass (DirAcc 口径)

new_covariate.name: social_media_sentiment
new_covariate.formula: 滚动7日微博/股吧情绪指数(正面评论占比-负面评论占比)的20日均线
new_covariate.mechanism: 鸡蛋消费与养殖周期受散户情绪驱动强烈：微博/股吧中养殖户讨论热度与情绪转向领先于补栏/淘汰决策，社交媒体情绪极端值预示供需预期反转。小农户信息不对称严重，情绪传播形成羊群效应，情绪指标在jd上比宏观数据更早捕捉周期拐点。

proposal.symbol_fit: 为何是 jd: 鸡蛋产业散户占比高，养殖户通过社交媒体交流补栏/淘汰决策；消费端季节性备货情绪也在社交平台发酵。jd的高波动性与散户主导特性使社交媒体情绪指标比工业品更有效，可捕捉散户行为的集体非理性。
proposal.predicted_direction: sentiment_extreme_high -> short (供给增加预期); sentiment_extreme_low -> long (供给收缩预期)
proposal.kill_condition: aligned dir_acc < 该品种 adaptive effective_min (约0.50-0.51) 即放弃
proposal.promote_condition: aligned gate_pass 且 fdr_pass (DirAcc 口径)

new_covariate.name: macro_sentiment_proxy
new_covariate.mechanism: 螺纹钢-热卷价差反映地产vs制造业景气度，结合基建政策预期构建宏观情绪代理。价差走阔=地产强于制造，缩窄=基建预期升温。宏观情绪周期领先价格1-2周。

proposal.symbol_fit: rb是地产/基建最直接的黑色品种，宏观情绪对其定价影响超过微观结构；螺卷价差是宏观晴雨表，具备预测能力。
proposal.predicted_direction: spread_widen + policy_ease -> long; spread_narrow + stimulus -> short
proposal.kill_condition: macro_proxy与rb价格相关性<0.25时放弃
proposal.promote_condition: 若实现后aligned gate_pass且fdr_pass

new_covariate.name: macro_sentiment
new_covariate.mechanism: 铁矿石作为钢铁上游原料，其价格受中国工业生产增速与房地产固定资产投资情绪驱动：当宏观景气指标（工业增加值同比+地产投资情绪）共振上行时，黑色系需求预期升温，期货价格领先现货反映宏观资金配置；该机制对地产链敏感品种(i, rb, jm)尤具解释力，捕捉大类资产轮动中的商品贝塔暴露。

proposal.symbol_fit: 为何是 i: 铁矿石62%进口依存度，中国地产+基建周期主导全球定价，宏观情绪传导最快。对比仅跟踪库存的 CCL，宏观情绪领先库存调整1-2个月，对趋势启动期的方向判断更具先导性。
proposal.predicted_direction: macro_sentiment_up -> long (工业+地产双扩张周期)
proposal.kill_condition: aligned dir_acc 低于该品种 adaptive effective_min (0.519) 即放弃，或宏观情绪与价格方向背离率>40%
proposal.promote_condition: aligned gate_pass 且 fdr_pass (DirAcc 口径)
proposal.mechanism: 宏观情绪通过资金配置渠道影响铁矿石期货：当工业景气+地产投资情绪共振上行，黑色系商品获得大类资产配置流入，期货贴水修复伴随价格上行；反之宏观衰退预期主导时，产业套保盘压制价格。该机制捕捉β暴露，与库存类信号形成互补。

new_covariate.name: ccl_gated_basis_momentum
new_covariate.mechanism: 乙二醇(eg)作为化工品，其基差受煤制/油制工艺切换与港口库存影响。CCL(仓差线)定位主力资金多空意图：当CCL为正(主力净多)且basis_momentum向上时，表明产业多头主动建库；CCL为负且basis_momentum向下时，表明套保盘压制近月。CCL门控basis_momentum可屏蔽无主力支持的伪基差信号。

proposal.symbol_fit: eg_basis_momentum单独失败(dir_acc=0.446)，但CCL反映的持仓结构可能提供缺失的确认层。eg的进口依赖度高，港口库存变化与主力资金方向常领先现货。CCL-gated机制测试『持仓确认+期限结构』的组合假说H_g2_02在化工进口品上的边界。
proposal.kill_condition: 若ccl_gated_basis_momentum的dir_acc <= eg_basis_momentum(0.446)，说明CCL门控无法挽救失败的term_structure信号
proposal.promote_condition: dir_acc >= 0.50且gate_pass=True，验证H_g2_02的组合机制可修复单covariate失效场景

new_covariate.name: oi_gated_basis_momentum
new_covariate.mechanism: 基差动量(basis_momentum)反映期现结构强弱，但信号易被库存波动噪声污染。持仓量变化(oi)作为资金流入的确认器：增仓伴随正向基差动量时，表明产业多头主动建库存；减仓伴随负向基差动量时，表明套保盘离场。OI门控机制仅在持仓确认时激活基差信号，屏蔽无资金支持的伪期限结构变化。

proposal.symbol_fit: p是进口依赖型棕榈油，其基差受马棕到港节奏与港口库存双重驱动。纯basis_momentum在p上硬门边缘(0.50)，而oi单独通过(0.568)。结合后可在『进口利润打开→增仓建库→基差走强』链条上形成共振信号，比单一covariate更精准捕捉p的库存-价格联动。
proposal.kill_condition: 若oi_gated_basis_momentum的dir_acc < p_basis_momentum(0.50)或<p_oi(0.568)，说明门控无增量价值
proposal.promote_condition: dir_acc >= 0.53且gate_pass=True，验证inventory+term_structure组合假说H_g2_02

new_covariate.name: rsi_slope_gated
new_covariate.mechanism: RSI斜率动量仅在趋势体制(H>0.5)下激活，震荡体制屏蔽假信号。测试对垂直整合品种(ss)是否有效。

proposal.mechanism: 不锈钢(ss)为垂直整合品种，套保盘主导，raw RSI slope曾以0.518接近门槛(要求0.520)。测试加入Hurst门控后能否过滤套保盘的噪声信号。若门控能挽救接近门槛的RSI信号，则证明体制过滤对垂直整合品种同样关键；若无效，则垂直整合导致的持仓结构问题无法通过门控解决。
proposal.symbol_fit: ss是镍-不锈钢产业链下游，受镍价传导和钢厂套保影响，RSI斜率曾被持仓结构噪声干扰。测试门控能否区分投机性动量与套保盘噪声。
proposal.kill_condition: aligned dir_acc < 0.520 或门控后信号频率<20%导致样本不足
proposal.promote_condition: aligned gate_pass 且 fdr_pass，且相对raw rsi_slope提升>=0.02
proposal.failure_delta: ss_rsi_slope已尝试(dir_acc=0.518)，本次加入Hurst门控作为过滤器，测试体制过滤能否解决垂直整合品种的持仓噪声问题。

new_covariate.name: crush_margin_spread
new_covariate.mechanism: 压榨利润反映油厂采购大豆的即时生产收益，是m价格的领先指标：高利润刺激油厂锁价采购，支撑豆粕基差；低利润导致油厂停机、豆粕供应收缩，价格上行。与单纯库存或持仓不同，crush_margin捕捉产业链利润传导，是m独有的结构性预测因子。

proposal.symbol_fit: 为何是m: 豆粕是典型压榨产业链品种，大豆-豆粕-豆油的压榨利润直接决定油厂开工率与库存策略，这是m区别于其他农产品的核心微观结构。
proposal.predicted_direction: crush_margin_high -> m_long (profit incentivizes crushing, supports meal basis)
proposal.kill_condition: 若压榨利润与豆粕价格相关性不显著或滞后关系不成立，放弃该因子
proposal.promote_condition: 压榨利润变化对m价格有显著领先性且能提升预测精度

new_covariate.name: eg_forward_curve_slope
new_covariate.formula: (futures_3m - futures_spot) / futures_spot normalized by historical basis variance
new_covariate.mechanism: Ethylene glycol term structure reflects inventory cycles and petrochemical plant maintenance schedules. Steep contango signals high inventory/overhang while backwardation indicates tight supply. The forward curve slope captures commercial hedging pressure that momentum misses due to EG's dominant commercial vs speculative participation.

proposal.symbol_fit: EG: Ethylene glycol is a pure industrial intermediate with dominant commercial hedging (polyester producers, MEG plants). Term structure captures inventory cycles and plant turnaround schedules that create predictable forward curve distortions invisible to momentum signals.
proposal.kill_condition: aligned dir_acc below 0.52 OR term_structure fails to outperform momentum baseline (0.48 on eg) => commercial hedging dynamics do not provide tradable edge
proposal.promote_condition: aligned gate_pass AND fdr_pass with dir_acc >= 0.525, demonstrating term_structure captures commercial inventory signals momentum misses

new_covariate.name: crush_margin_momentum
new_covariate.mechanism: Crush margin (soybean meal minus input soybean cost) slope captures the directional momentum of processing profitability rather than just price levels. Positive crush margin momentum signals expanding processor profitability and typically leads increased meal production and inventory builds, creating predictable forward price pressure distinct from raw price momentum.

proposal.symbol_fit: Soybean meal is the output of the crush process; its price dynamics are driven by crush margin cycles rather than standalone momentum. Standard price momentum fails because it ignores input cost dynamics; crush margin momentum captures the economically-relevant signal for crush-driven commodities.
proposal.kill_condition: If crush margin momentum shows <0.52 directional accuracy on M, the mechanism does not add value beyond standard price momentum for crush commodities.
proposal.promote_condition: aligned gate_pass AND fdr_pass with dir_acc >=0.55 would promote crush-margin-derived indicators as family extension for term_structure on crush commodities

new_covariate.name: combined_positioning_seasonality
new_covariate.formula: ccl_aligned * calendar_cyclical_signal where ccl_direction matches calendar_phase expectation
new_covariate.mechanism: Combined signal activates only when inventory positioning aligns with calendar seasonality. For biological commodities commercial hedgers position ahead of known supply windows. This covariate multiplies CCL direction by calendar cyclical signal when they agree and zeros when they conflict. H_g2_01 claims this combined signal outperforms either alone. Testing requires comparing standalone calendar standalone CCL and combined signal on biological commodities. This implements the synergy mechanism claimed by H_g2_01.

proposal.symbol_fit: Eggs jd are biological commodities with clear production cycles and commercial hedging. This combined covariate tests H_g2_01 core claim that inventory-calendar synergies exist. If the combined signal works it validates the synergy hypothesis. If standalone components work but combined fails it suggests interaction effects are negative.
proposal.kill_condition: combined signal underperforms best standalone component => H_g2_01 synergy claim falsified
proposal.promote_condition: combined signal achieves dir_acc >= 0.525 AND outperforms both standalone signals => synergy mechanism validated
proposal.failure_delta: No prior combined positioning seasonality attempts. This is a new covariate proposal for the host backlog implementing H_g2_01 claimed synergy mechanism.

new_covariate.name: sentiment_zscore
new_covariate.mechanism: 情绪Z分数：量价齐升时的投机情绪极端值度量。当成交量比率(当前/20日均量)与价格加速度的乘积偏离历史中枢超过2个标准差时，标志散户追涨情绪过热，随后均值回归。

proposal.mechanism: 鸡蛋(eg)作为小品种生鲜品，其价格易受短期情绪驱动产生极端波动。sentiment_zscore捕捉量价齐升时的投机情绪极值，当情绪Z分数突破+2时标志散户追涨过热、随后均值回归，突破-2时标志恐慌抛售、随后反弹修复。
proposal.symbol_fit: 为何是eg: 鸡蛋产业链散户参与度高、投机性强，价格易受情绪周期驱动；宏观情绪指标在eg这种高波动小品种上比低频基本面数据更敏感，能及时捕捉情绪极值反转点。
proposal.kill_condition: aligned dir_acc 低于 eg 品种 adaptive effective_min (约0.52) 即放弃，或 n_eff < 50
proposal.promote_condition: aligned gate_pass 且 fdr_pass (DirAcc 口径)

new_covariate.name: commodity_fx_proxy
new_covariate.mechanism: 商品货币代理：白糖作为全球化农产品，其价格与新兴市场货币 basket 的相关性反映全球需求预期。当相关性由负转正时，标志宏观资金开始配置商品资产。

proposal.mechanism: 白糖(sr)作为全球化程度高的软商品，其价格走势与新兴市场货币 basket 和全球风险偏好高度相关。commodity_fx_proxy捕捉sr与商品货币的相关性变化，当相关性由负转正时标志宏观资金开始配置商品资产、需求预期升温；相关性由正转负时标志避险资金撤离、需求预期降温。
proposal.symbol_fit: 为何是sr: 白糖是全球贸易量最大的软商品之一，进口依赖度高的特点使其价格对汇率和宏观资金流动敏感；sr当前0/9过门无macro_sentiment尝试，是测试宏观情绪机制的理想标的。
proposal.kill_condition: aligned dir_acc 低于 sr 品种 adaptive effective_min (约0.52) 即放弃，或 macro_sentiment 数据缺口导致 n_eff < 50
proposal.promote_condition: aligned gate_pass 且 fdr_pass (DirAcc 口径)

new_covariate.name: volume_profile
new_covariate.formula: volume_at_price_level / total_volume over rolling window, identifying high-volume nodes as support/resistance
new_covariate.mechanism: 成交量分布(Volume Profile)识别特定价格区间的密集成交区域作为支撑/阻力位。当价格突破高成交量节点(HVN)时，表明该价位共识被打破，趋势延续概率高；当价格测试低成交量节点(LVN)时，因缺乏成交共识，价格易快速穿越。该机制结合持仓量(资金流入)与成交量分布(价格共识)，对工业品种的趋势启动和衰竭提供增量信号。

proposal.symbol_fit: i为高度流动性工业品种，成交量分布能有效识别主力资金建仓价位。相比单纯持仓量(oi)或仓差(ccl)，volume_profile结合价格与成交量，对突破真伪的过滤更精确。
proposal.kill_condition: 若volume_profile无法在i上达到oi_gated_momentum同等水平(dir_acc < 0.515)，说明成交量分布对趋势性品种无增量价值
proposal.promote_condition: volume_profile achieves dir_acc >= 0.52 with gate_pass, establishing new inventory family covariate for trending symbols

new_covariate.name: derivative_distance
new_covariate.formula: categorical_encode(feedstock_distance) * crack_spread_zscore: where feedstock_distance is 0 for direct fuels, 1 for first derivatives (px, aromatics), 2 for second derivatives (eg, meg)
new_covariate.mechanism: Explicitly models H_g2_04's transmission gradient claim as an interaction term: crack_spread signal strength should decay with derivative distance from feedstock. This covariate encodes the hierarchical distance and tests whether the interaction improves prediction over raw crack_spread_zscore. If the interaction term is insignificant, H_g2_04's distance hierarchy is falsified.

proposal.symbol_fit: Cross-symbol test: compare coefficient magnitude across eg(2), px(1), and any direct fuel(0). If coefficient monotonically decreases with distance, H_g2_04 is supported; if flat or inverted, falsified.
proposal.predicted_direction: derivative_distance * crack_spread_zscore interaction: coefficient < 0 (signal attenuation with distance)
proposal.kill_condition: Interaction term coefficient insignificant or positive, falsifying distance-based attenuation
proposal.promote_condition: Significant negative interaction coefficient and improved DirAcc over unconditioned crack_spread_zscore

new_covariate.name: commodity_beta
new_covariate.mechanism: Commodity futures exhibit time-varying beta to a broad commodity index reflecting macro risk-on/risk-off regimes. High beta (>1) during synchronized global growth phases amplifies individual commodity moves; low beta (<0.5) during idiosyncratic supply shocks decouples price from macro trends. The signal uses rolling 20-period regression beta against a broad commodity basket (excludes the target symbol), normalized by beta volatility to identify regime shifts.

proposal.symbol_fit: 为何是 m: 豆粕为蛋白饲料核心品种，与全球粮食价格、能源成本（种植/运输）、美元汇率存在宏观联动。其beta对大宗商品指数敏感，能捕捉宏观风险情绪切换。
proposal.kill_condition: aligned dir_acc < 0.50 即放弃该宏观联动机制
proposal.promote_condition: aligned gate_pass=True 且 fdr_pass 即宏观beta机制有效

new_covariate.name: volatility_inventory_fusion
new_covariate.formula: bb_squeeze_compression_state * sign(ccl_change) when squeeze_compression < threshold AND |ccl_change| > min_ccl_delta
new_covariate.mechanism: 波动率-持仓融合信号：在布林带挤压(volatility压缩)状态下，用CCL(仓差线)方向预测突破方向。当波动率压缩至极低水平时，价格即将选择方向；此时主力资金持仓变化(CCL)的方向往往领先于价格突破，反映产业资金的预期。该融合信号在低波动蓄势期提供方向预测，在趋势展开期退出。

proposal.symbol_fit: 该融合信号最适合库存周期明显的工业品种(jm, fg, i)。这些品种在波动率压缩期往往对应产业观望情绪，而CCL能捕捉产业资金的领先布局。与单一bb_squeeze相比，融合信号增加了方向预测能力；与单一CCL相比，融合信号过滤了高波动期的噪声。
proposal.predicted_direction: squeeze_compression + positive_ccl -> long; squeeze_compression + negative_ccl -> short
proposal.kill_condition: 融合信号未优于独立bb_squeeze+CCL简单叠加即放弃，或CCL方向与突破方向相关性<0.55
proposal.promote_condition: 融合信号aligned dir_acc > standalone bb_squeeze 且通过BH-FDR检验

new_covariate.name: policy_regime
new_covariate.mechanism: 螺纹钢价格受地产政策、环保限产、基建投资等行政干预强烈。policy_regime协变量通过识别政策窗口期(两会、环保督查、地产调控放松/收紧)切换模型预测权重——政策敏感期降低库存/基差信号权重，提升动量跟随权重。

proposal.symbol_fit: 为何是rb: 螺纹钢是中国特色政策驱动品种，价格对行政限产、地产调控、基建刺激的敏感度远超基本面。现有协变量未显式建模政策体制切换。
proposal.predicted_direction: policy tightening regime -> short rb (demand destruction); policy easing -> long rb
proposal.kill_condition: regime detection noise > signal, dir_acc not improved over baseline
proposal.promote_condition: regime-aware predictions show DirAcc improvement over static model
